sources.title: Li River in Guilin: 5 Ways to Enjoy the Best Scenery
sources.content:
Li River in Guilin: Complete Text Content

Introduction
The Li River spans 83 kilometers from Guilin to Yangshuo, with the "Yangdi to Xingping section" offering the most spectacular scenery. Notable landmarks include Nine-Horse Fresco Hill and Yellow Cloth Shoal, featured on China's 20-yuan banknote. Multiple ways exist to experience this landscape: cruising offers comfort with air conditioning and dining; hiking provides intimate riverside immersion; bamboo rafting delivers serene traditional experiences; mountain viewpoints showcase panoramic vistas; and cycling connects ancient villages through countryside paths.

1. Li River Cruise
Over 90% of visitors choose cruising as their exploration method. The 4-hour journey provides "360-degree views of the river" and photographic opportunities from open decks.

Boat Classes:
- 3-star boats: ~120 passengers, basic seating, simple boxed lunches
- 4-star boats: 75-80 passengers, spacious leather sofas, buffet meals (approximately $20 more expensive)

Key Details:
- Cruise terminal: 25 km from downtown Guilin (50-minute drive)
- Departure times: 9:00-10:30 AM
- Upper deck's left side offers best photo angles
- Peak season booking: reserve 1 month in advance

2. Bamboo Rafting
Traditional rafts steered by local boatmen provide intimate river encounters. "The classic Yangdi to Xingping route (1.5 hours)" passes iconic sights including Nine-Horse Fresco Hill and Yellow Cloth Shoal.

Specifications:
- Capacity: 4 passengers per raft
- Duration: 1.5 hours
- Safety: Life jackets mandatory; experienced boatmen; professional safety gear
- Restrictions: Children under 7 years/1.2m height; seniors over 70 years
- Weather advisory: May suspend during rainy season flooding

3. Hiking Along Li River
Three recommended routes accommodate different fitness levels:
- Option 1: Quanjiazhou to Xingping (12 km, 4 hours)
- Option 2: Quanjiazhou to Nine-Horse Fresco Hill (6 km, 2 hours)
- Option 3: Combined rafting plus hiking (6 km total)

Trails feature pebble riverbanks and countryside paths passing ancient villages, rice paddies, and karst peaks. Best seasons: "Autumn (September-November)" with crisp air, or "May offers mild temperatures with less rain."

4. Mountain Vista Viewpoints
Caoping Dashawan Viewpoint: Features mountain ranges with distant river views. 1.5-hour drive from Guilin. Easy 20-minute stone stair climb. Best time: 5-6 PM for sunset lighting.

Xianggong Hill: Direct overhead views of Li River's "First Bend" and Nine-Horse Fresco Hill. Steepest 20-minute stone staircase climb. 2-hour drive from Guilin (50 minutes from Yangshuo/Xingping). Best time: 5-6 AM sunrise.

5. Biking Routes
Daxu to Xingping Route: 47 km distance (5 hours). Well-maintained, mostly paved roads. Passes ancient hamlets and rice paddies.
Shorter Alternative - Xingping to Yangdi: 30 km distance (3 hours). Equally stunning scenery with less effort.

Best Seasons: "Autumn (Sept-Nov)" offers cool, dry weather; "Spring (Mar-May)" provides pleasant temperatures despite higher rain probability.

sources.title: A Li River Cruise: Everything You Should Know Before Ordering Your Tickets
sources.content:
Li River Cruise: Complete Text Content

Introduction
"Spending half a day enjoying the peaceful views along the Li River is an essential experience when you're in Yangshuo." The cruise offers comfortable travel compared to hiking or biking alongside the river.

Route & Highlights
The journey spans from Zhujiang/Mopanshan Pier to Yangshuo, featuring scenic stops including "Elephant Trunk Hill, Wangfu Rock, Nine Horses Fresco Hill, 20-Yuan Banknote Hill" and other notable landmarks.

Basic Details
- Duration: 4 to 5 hours
- Boarding: 9am to 9:30am
- Arrival: 1:30pm to 3:30pm
- Suitability: "Age suitability: 7 to 70 years"
- Best periods: April and October offer comfortable conditions
- Peak season: April through October
- Off-season: November to March (limited Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday service)

4-Star Cruise Features
Higher capacity vessels accommodate "72 to 80 passengers" with professional English-speaking guides, air conditioning, Western toilets, and superior dining. "Book your cruise 15 days in advance."

3-Star Cruise Features
Budget-friendly option accommodates "120 to 150" passengers with basic amenities and fundamental meal service.

Practical Travel Tips
Book "15 to 30 days in advance," prepare supplies beforehand as "there won't be any stops," monitor weather forecasts, and avoid purchasing items onboard to prevent tourist scams.

sources.title: Li River, Guilin, Guangxi, China: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Li River, Guilin: Complete Travel Guide

Overview
The Li River flows approximately 83 kilometers from Guilin to Yangshuo in Guangxi's Zhuang Autonomous Region. It's part of the South China Karst UNESCO World Heritage Site and features distinctive karst topography—needle-like limestone peaks shaped by millions of years of erosion.

Three Ways to Experience the River

1. Classic Cruise (4-5 hours)
- 3-Star Boats: Budget option ($60-80 USD), departs Mopanshan Pier, accommodates 100-150 passengers, squat toilets, simple box lunch
- 4-Star Boats: Premium option ($90-120 USD), departs Zhujiang Pier, 70-80 passengers, Western toilets, buffet lunch
- Route covers approximately 50 miles from Guilin to Yangshuo
- Luggage permitted

2. Motorized Bamboo Raft (1-2 hours)
- Routes: Yangdi to Nine Horse Fresco Hill or Xingping to Nine Horse Fresco Hill
- Features loud diesel engines (earplugs recommended)
- Strict age/height restrictions: children must exceed 1.2 meters, minimum age 7, no passengers over 70
- No luggage allowed
- Includes life jacket requirement

3. Hiking
- 12-15 kilometer trail from Yangdi to Xingping
- Requires local ferry crossings (10-15 RMB per crossing)
- Check ferry availability before departing

Key Landmarks
Nine Horse Fresco Hill: Massive cliff face with weathered patterns; legend claims spotting all nine horses predicts political success
Yellow Cloth Shoal: Calm water section with perfect reflections of surrounding peaks
The 20 RMB View: Located near Xingping; matches imagery on Chinese currency
Xingping Ancient Town: Over 1,300 years old, features preserved Ming Dynasty architecture

Best Travel Times
- Autumn (Sept-Nov): Clear skies, comfortable temperatures, osmanthus flowers blooming - 5 stars
- Spring (Mar-May): Misty atmosphere creating "ink painting" effect - 4 stars
- Summer (Jun-Aug): Hot, stormy, crowds - 3 stars
- Winter (Dec-Feb): Cold, low water levels, fewer tourists - 2 stars

Practical Information
Getting to Piers:
- Mopanshan Pier (3-Star): 30km, 45-60 minutes from Guilin, ~100-120 RMB taxi
- Zhujiang Pier (4-Star): 32km, 50-60 minutes from Guilin, ~120-150 RMB taxi
- Tip: Book hotel transfers to avoid morning stress

Arrival in Yangshuo: Cruises end at Longtoushan Pier; electric golf carts shuttle passengers to West Street town center for approximately 15 RMB per person

Booking Tips:
- Pre-book 3-7 days in advance; tickets sell out quickly
- Passport required for booking and boarding
- Book through agencies or hotels for reliability

Special Experiences
Cormorant Fishing: Traditional evening shows where fishermen use trained birds to catch fish. Mostly tourist-oriented now but visually stunning.

Practical Tips
- Bring toilet paper for boat restrooms
- Apply sunscreen before boarding; water reflection intensifies UV rays
- Wear polarized sunglasses to see into water
- Earplugs recommended for bamboo rafts
- Avoid swimming; strong currents and boat traffic create hazards

FAQ Answers
Is the 4-star upgrade worthwhile? Yes—the comfort difference is significant; extra space, superior amenities, and better food justify the $25-30 premium.
Does the cruise operate during rain? Yes; rain enhances atmospheric effects creating "ink painting" scenery. Ponchos available at piers.
Is the bamboo raft safe? Yes; rafts undergo inspection, drivers are licensed, and life jackets are mandatory.

sources.title: Li River Boat Cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo - Phil and Garth
sources.content:
Li River Boat Cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo

Most people take a river cruise down the picturesque Li River from the Zhejiang Wharf about 40 minutes outside Guilin. The 83-kilometer section between Guilin and Yangshuo is the most beautiful part and enjoys the reputation of being a "River Art Gallery".

The trip of Li River Cruise will be about 4 hours in total. Li River cruises are mainly divided into 3-star and 4-star boats based on price and amenities. While similar in size, the 3-star boats accommodate around 120 passengers with basic seating, while the 4-star boats offer more spacious leather sofas for only 75-80 guests.

When choosing seats, the upper deck's left side offers the best views and photo opportunities.

Pinnacled peaks pop up and surprise visitors at each bend of the river. Water buffalos patrol on the fields; ducks paddle in the waters; peasants reap paddies in front of village houses; fishermen use the cormorants to catch the fish and return them to the boat and kids go home singing songs. All these create an idyllic and beautiful scene of the life removed from concrete cities.

The best time to visit is from April to October. The scenery is most beautiful during this time, especially from April to May when misty mountains and rivers create a unique atmosphere.

Most cruises depart from Guilin between 9:00-10:00am, and it takes about 1.5 hours to get to Zhujiang or Mopanshan dock from Guilin city center.

sources.title: Li River Cruise: From Guilin to Yangshuo by Boat
sources.content:
Li River Cruise: From Guilin to Yangshuo by Boat

4-star Li River cruises depart in the morning, typically around 9:20 am and arrive at Yangshuo around 1:30 pm. The entire cruise lasts about 4 hours.

Ticket prices vary from 360 to 480 yuan per person, with children's tickets priced at 180 to 240 yuan per person, depending on the cabin location.

Zhujiang Pier serves as the departure point for 4-star Li River cruises and is located at No. 091 County Road, Yanshan District, Guilin. A taxi from Guilin city center to Zhujiang Pier costs about 100 yuan.

Li River cruises are mainly divided into 3-star and 4-star boats based on price and amenities. 4-star or above cruises feature more elegant interiors and offer a buffet lunch.

There are two ways to book tickets for a Li River cruise: through the official Li River Cruise WeChat account or at the dock. During peak seasons, tickets sell out quickly, and you should book at least 1 month in advance to secure your spot.

The best time to take a Li River cruise is generally from April to early November, when the weather is warm and the lush greenery enhances the beauty of the karst mountains.

sources.title: 桂林市漓江景区_百度百科
sources.content:
桂林市漓江风景区 - 百度百科

基本概况
桂林市漓江风景区是广西壮族自治区的国家5A级旅游景区，位于阳朔县境内。景区以"漓江桂林至阳朔段83公里水域为核心的喀斯特地貌景观区"著称，2007年5月8日获评5A级景区。

发展历史
该景区历史渊源深远。公元前214年，秦始皇决定修筑灵渠工程，连接湘江与漓江，促进"中原与岭南交流"。20世纪70年代，漓江旅游正式起步；1973年游客接待量开始稳步增长；2000年获首批国家AAAA级旅游景区。

地理位置与气候
景区跨越杨堤、兴坪、阳朔等核心区域，占地面积303.2平方公里。所在地属"中亚热带季风气候区，热量丰富，雨量充沛，日照充足"。

主要景点
著名景观包括：甲天下风光、九马画山、黄布倒影、碧莲峰、相公山等。其中"黄布倒影"被中国作为自然景观代表参展国际旅游博览会。

旅游信息
- 开放时间：8:00-18:00
- 门票价格：210元/人次
- 游览路线：多条竹筏游线路可选，从50分钟至110分钟不等

漓江风景名胜区规划总面积1159.4平方公里，以"山清、水秀、洞奇、石美"四绝闻名，又有"洲绿、滩险、潭深、瀑飞"之胜，人称"百里漓江、百里画廊"。1982年11月被国务院列为第一批国家重点风景名胜区。

sources.title: 桂林漓江风景区门票价格 - 阳朔旅游
sources.content:
桂林漓江风景区门票信息

漓江景区大门门票免费，但游船需要另外收费。

旺季（4-11月及春节假期）：
- 甲类（超豪华空调船）散客450元/人，团体400元/人
- 乙类（豪华空调船）散客270元/人，团体240元/人
- 丙类（普通空调船）散客210元/人，团体200元/人

淡季（12月-次年3月）：
- 甲类散客380元/人，团体350元/人
- 乙类散客240元/人，团体210元/人
- 丙类散客190元/人，团体180元/人

甲类和丙类门票分别免费向游客提供中式经济餐和中式自助餐。

游览漓江风景的方式包括坐游船、徒步、骑行和漂流。如果选择竹筏游览，杨堤至兴坪段的竹筏游览价格较大船船票便宜一些。

最佳旅游季节：四季皆宜，4、5月份观雨中漓江的朦胧之美；9月11月价格较便宜，可观山间秋色。

主要景点：草坪、象鼻山、父子岩、斗鸡山、卫家渡、大圩古镇、黄牛峡、奇峰镇、磨盘山码头、訾洲、净瓶山、冠岩、绣山、乡吧岛、半边渡、桃源村、望夫石、九马画山、童子拜观音、卓笔峰、月光岛、鲤鱼挂壁、螺狮山、朝板山、兴坪渔村、书童山、碧莲峰等。

sources.title: 漓江旅游攻略 - 知乎
sources.content:
漓江旅游攻略

漓江是桂林旅游的精华所在，以"山清、水秀、洞奇、石美"四绝闻名于世。漓江起点为兴安县溶江镇灵渠口，终点为平乐三江口，全长164公里。其中桂林至阳朔段83公里是最精华的游览区域，被誉为"百里画廊"。

游览方式：
1. 大船游览（桂林-阳朔）：全程约4-5小时，船票210-450元不等
2. 竹筏漂流（杨堤-兴坪段）：约1.5小时，体验最原始的漓江风光
3. 徒步（杨堤-兴坪）：约4小时，最深入的漓江体验
4. 骑行：沿漓江边的乡间小路骑行

最佳游览季节：4-10月最佳，其中4-5月烟雨漓江最为迷人；9-10月秋高气爽，天气舒适。冬季（12-2月）水位较低，不建议游览。
